description: This file defines the GatewayResponse class, which models the response received from the eWay payment gateway. It includes parsing logic for XML responses, getter methods for response fields, and handles various transaction details like status, amount, error messages, and transaction identifiers.

classes.name: GatewayResponse
classes.description: Represents and parses the XML response from the eWay payment gateway, providing access to various transaction details and status.

methods.name: getTrxnNumber
methods.description: Returns the transaction number from the response.

methods.name: getTrxnError
methods.description: Returns any error message from the transaction.

methods.name: getReturnAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount in cents.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a BigDecimal in standard currency units.

methods.name: getTrxnStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the transaction (success or failure).

methods.name: getBeagleScore
methods.description: Returns the Beagle score if available, otherwise -1.

methods.name: GatewayResponse
methods.description: Constructor that parses an XML response stream to populate the response fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the response in XML format.
